name: Digital Nomad Visa
summary: Residence route for non-EU remote workers, for up to 3 years. Invest Cyprus gives no other terms. Income and employer rules were not confirmed on an official page I could open.

other: Income, employer, fee and quota rules not confirmed. The Migration Department pages were blocked to automated access. Check the Cyprus Migration Department digital nomad page before applying.

name: Temporary Work and Residence Permit (non-EU employees)
summary: Non-EU employees can get a temporary work and residence permit of up to 3 years, renewable. Invest Cyprus says the application for permanent or long-term residence based on employment has been simplified. Exact conditions not confirmed.

other: Spouses of employees earning at least 2,500 EUR gross per month get free access to the labor market, per Invest Cyprus. Other conditions not confirmed.
Invest Cyprus also lists a 50% income tax exemption for new non-domiciled employees earning 55,000 EUR or more, valid 17 years. That is a tax rule, not an immigration rule.

name: Invest Cyprus Business and Relocation Facilitation
summary: Invest Cyprus is the official agency that helps foreign companies set up and relocate staff and family. It is a support service. Residence terms for founders and investors were not confirmed.

other: Permit conditions for investors and founders not confirmed. Contact Invest Cyprus or the Migration Department.

name: Naturalization
summary: Invest Cyprus mentions reduced naturalization for non-EU nationals, with no figures. Years of residence, language test and dual citizenship rules not confirmed.

other: Residence years, language and test requirements not confirmed on an official page I could open.
